cards.name: Ripples

(Thumbnail: one instance placed from the library and fitted to 300 pt on white, applied by script; natural size about 154 x 43 pt; not a shipped preview.)
use_for: water-surface and ripple texture sprayed over shapes

cards.applies_to: the artboard of an open document: placing it creates a symbol instance, a linked copy of the symbol definition that can be moved, scaled and rotated like any object; the symbol must exist in the target document (placing from the library copies it in)

verified.note: Clusters of long thin wavy grey streaks fading at the ends.
